visual_action: A slideshow of still images and text overlays presents a timeline of alleged racist actions and statements by Donald Trump. The video includes historical photos of Trump, his properties like the Taj Mahal and Trump Plaza, a promotional image for his TV show 'The Apprentice', and a screenshot of one of his tweets. The final slide shows a photo of Trump with several of his controversial quotes overlaid on it.
